channel.title: Marin Lazic: Insights
channel.description: Research linked articles on training, recovery, sleep and nutrition for founders and busy professionals.

item.title: Creatine for Executives: A Practical, Evidence Based Guide
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: How creatine monohydrate may support training and energy, how to use it, what the evidence says about cognition, and when to ask a clinician.

item.title: How to Improve Sleep Quality: Practical Steps That Help
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: Improve sleep with a regular wake time, a calm bedroom, sensible light and caffeine habits, and clear guidance on when to seek medical help.

item.title: How to Boost Your HRV: A Practical, Evidence Aware Guide
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: Learn how to track HRV sensibly and support it with sleep, breathing, movement, alcohol awareness and safe recovery habits.

item.title: How to Lose Fat Without Losing Performance
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: A practical, evidence informed guide to losing fat while supporting strength, recovery and day to day performance.

item.title: How to Do a Chin Up: A Practical Progression From Your First Rep to More Reps
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: Learn safe chin up technique, progress from hangs and rows to full reps, and adjust training for your current strength, grip and shoulder comfort.

item.title: Periodisation for Non Athletes: A Practical Guide to Training Phases
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: Periodisation gives busy adults a flexible way to plan training, manage fatigue and review progress without treating a template as a promise.

item.title: Alcohol and Performance: What the Data Says
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: Alcohol can affect sleep, coordination and recovery. Learn what the evidence supports and how to make lower risk choices around training.

item.title: WHOOP for Business: A Practical Guide to Performance Data
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: Use WHOOP trends to guide sleep, training and workload decisions without treating wearable scores as diagnoses or guarantees.

item.title: Olympic Training Principles for Sustainable Business Performance
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: Use training, recovery and load management principles to plan work and exercise without treating athletic success as a business guarantee.

item.title: CEO Burnout Recovery Protocol: A Practical, Evidence Aware Starting Point
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: A practical starting point for workplace exhaustion, covering workload, sleep, training, wearable limits and when to seek clinical care.

item.title: Executive Fitness After 40: A Practical Strength, Cardio and Recovery Plan
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: A practical, evidence aware fitness framework for busy executives over 40, covering strength, cardio, sleep, supplements, HRV and when to seek clinical help.

item.title: Morning Routines for Executives: Use Data, Not Podcasts
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: A practical, evidence aware morning routine for executives. Protect sleep, use morning light, track useful trends, and adjust the plan to your own needs.

item.title: Zone 2 Training for Busy Professionals: A Practical Guide
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: A practical, evidence aware guide to Zone 2 training, intensity cues, weekly planning, recovery tracking and safe progression for busy professionals.

item.title: A Founder’s Guide to a Practical Stress Management System
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: A practical stress review for founders, covering workload, recovery habits, wearable limits and when to seek healthcare support.

item.title: VO2 Max for Executives: A Useful Fitness and Longevity Metric
item.dc:creator: Marin Lazic
item.description: VO2 max is a useful measure of aerobic fitness. Learn what it shows, how to test it, and how to build fitness safely around a busy schedule.
